elements.text: The Interaction Canvas explores the flow; REST, Event or GraphQL canvases refine the chosen style.

notes:
APIOps introduction. Technical continuation is illustrative; no client implementation or measured improvement is claimed.

Canonical design resource mapping includes domain and interaction modelling, style-specific canvases and contract-first guidance. These interactions are options for a fictional example, not a mandate to implement every style. The final choice depends on consumer tasks and reviewed architecture.
